_meta.definition: Objective inputs taken from a filing where Yahoo is wrong. Read by refresh_objective_inputs.py and refresh_reverse_dcf.py via scripts/filing_overrides.py. 'fixed' values replace Yahoo's; FCF yield and EV/FCF are recomputed from the 'ev' block at the current market cap every run.
_meta.expiry: An entry applies only while Yahoo's mostRecentQuarter equals period_end. When a newer quarter is reported the refresh writes Yahoo's values and flags FILING OVERRIDE EXPIRED: check them against the new filing, then update or remove the entry.
_meta.when_to_add: A fresh listing or capital-structure change where Yahoo's statements lag the filing or misread it (cite the filing and show the arithmetic in the name's briefing).

ANT.basis: TTM Q4'25-Q3'26 from the prospectus. ROIC: op. income -$4,096M x (1-0.21) / (TA $154,320M - CL $11,671M). Gross margin: functional cost of revenue $5,789M on revenue $35,282M. FCF: OCF $5,956M - PP&E $945M - leased-asset prepayments $1,958M = $3,053M. ND/EBITDA: EBITDA <= 0 with net cash after the IPO -> 0 (rule 15 stand-in). EV: cash $244,552M (pro forma as adjusted $232,351M + greenshoe $12,201M); Amazon rollover notes valued as 1,547,676,309 shares at market; revolver undrawn. Arithmetic in per-stock/ANT/context-2026-11-21.md.
